fields.text: Carve a design into a pumpkin, then play the carving. Muse draws a flat black stencil, Nano Banana Edit carves that exact stencil into a pumpkin on a dusk porch, and Muse Edit takes the carving back out to get a clean plate of the same shot. MiniMax H3 Max Turbo gets the clean pumpkin on its image port and the carved one on its end-frame port, so the clip starts uncarved and ends lit. Swap the stencil prompt for your own design, or the pumpkin for a wall, a cake or a wooden sign. Inspired by @jp_costa's ComfyUI pumpkin-carving workflow (https://x.com/jp_costa/status/2115525910254530758).

A pumpkin-carving stencil: one bold flat design in solid black shapes on a plain white background. An invented round little owl with big round eyes and two pointed ear tufts, perched on a thin crescent moon, with three small five-pointed stars around it. Simple thick shapes with clean edges and wide gaps between them, like a paper cut-out template, no thin lines, no shading, no gradients. Centered with a white margin all around. No text, no letters, no logos.

Look: cozy photoreal still life at dusk, one large round orange pumpkin with a curly green stem sitting on a weathered wooden porch step, dark blue evening background with soft out-of-focus fairy lights, shallow depth of field, eye-level close-up, the pumpkin fills the center of the frame. Carve this exact design into the front of the pumpkin as a jack-o'-lantern: every black shape of the design is cut clean through the skin, keeping the same owl, crescent moon and three stars in the same layout. A candle inside glows warm orange-yellow through the cut-out shapes, a few small carved pumpkin chips lie on the step beside it. No hands, no people, no knife, no text, no logos.

Clean plate: show this exact same photo with the carving undone. Keep the same pumpkin with the same shape, size, ribs, color and curly green stem, in exactly the same place on the same wooden porch step, with the same camera, framing, dark blue dusk background and fairy lights. Change only the front of the pumpkin: its skin is whole, smooth and uncut, with no holes, no design and no glow from inside, lit softly by the dusk and the fairy lights. Remove the pumpkin chips from the step. No hands, no people, no text.

Look: cozy photoreal still life at dusk, one large round orange pumpkin with a curved stem on a weathered wooden porch step, dark blue evening background with soft out-of-focus fairy lights, shallow depth of field, eye-level close-up. One continuous locked-off shot, the camera never moves. The whole uncarved pumpkin sits still in the dusk. Then thin glowing lines trace an owl, a crescent moon and three stars across its skin as if drawn by an invisible blade. The crescent moon and the owl's eye rings pop out cleanly and the pieces tumble onto the step at the right, while the owl's body and the stars are shaved into the skin. A candle inside flickers on and warm orange light pours out through the cut shapes. No hands, no knife, no people, no text.
